cards.ex: We should dress up for the party tonight; it's a fancy restaurant.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun ziyofat uchun chiroyli kiyinishimiz kerak; bu hashamatli restoran.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli va rasmiy kiyim kiyish, maxsus holat uchun.

cards.ex: It's Friday, so we can dress down at work.
cards.exUz: Bugun juma, shuning uchun biz ishda oddiyroq kiyinishimiz mumkin.

cards.ex: She's very fashion-forward and always wears the latest trends.
cards.exUz: U juda moda oldinda va har doim eng so'nggi tendentsiyalarni kiyadi.

cards.ex: I can't believe she can pull off that crazy hat!
cards.exUz: Men uning bu telba shlyapani eplay olganiga ishonmayman!
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki g'ayrioddiy narsani muvaffaqiyatli bajarmoq, kiyish.

cards.ex: I like to mix and match different styles to create my own look.
cards.exUz: O'z uslubimni yaratish uchun turli xil uslublarni moslashtirishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil kiyimlarni bir-biriga moslab kiyish.

cards.ex: That necklace is a real statement piece; it really stands out.
cards.exUz: Bu marjon haqiqiy e'tiborli buyum; u haqiqatan ham ajralib turadi.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborni tortadigan, o'ziga xos kiyim yoki aksessuar.

cards.ex: A classic white shirt is a wardrobe staple.
cards.exUz: Klassik oq ko'ylak - shkafning asosiy qismidir.
cards.uzDef: Har bir shkafda bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan asosiy kiyim.

cards.ex: I just bought this dress off the rack; it's not custom-made.
cards.exUz: Men bu ko'ylakni do'kondan tayyor sotib oldim; u buyurtma asosida qilinmagan.

cards.ex: That color is really on trend this season.
cards.exUz: Bu rang bu mavsumda juda modada.

cards.ex: Those bell-bottom jeans are totally out of fashion now.
cards.exUz: Bu qo'ng'iroq taglikli jinsi shimlar hozirda umuman modadan tashqari.

cards.ex: She's such a fashion victim; she'll wear anything that's in style, even if it doesn't suit her.
cards.exUz: U shunday moda qurboni; u uslubda bo'lgan har qanday narsani kiyadi, hatto u unga mos kelmasa ham.

cards.ex: You can accessorize a simple dress with a scarf and some jewelry.
cards.exUz: Oddiy ko'ylakni ro'mol va bir nechta zargarlik buyumlari bilan to'ldirishingiz mumkin.

cards.ex: These jeans are hand-me-downs from my older brother.
cards.exUz: Bu jinsi shimlar akamdan meros qolgan.
cards.uzDef: Oldin ishlatilgan va boshqaga berilgan kiyim.

cards.ex: I'm going to try on this shirt to see if it fits.
cards.exUz: Men bu ko'ylakni mos kelishini ko'rish uchun kiyib ko'rmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Kiyimni sotib olishdan oldin o'lchamini bilish uchun kiyib ko'rish.

cards.ex: "I think that dress is too formal." "Suit yourself, I like it."
cards.exUz: "Menimcha, bu ko'ylak juda rasmiy." "O'zing bilasan, menga yoqadi."

cards.ex: Put on your coat, it's cold outside.
cards.exUz: Paltoingni kiy, tashqarida sovuq.

cards.ex: Take off your shoes when you come inside.
cards.exUz: Ichkariga kirganingizda poyafzalingizni yeching.

cards.ex: Zip up your jacket, it's windy.
cards.exUz: Kurtkangizni qulflang, shamol bor.

cards.ex: Button up your shirt, it's a bit chilly.
cards.exUz: Ko'ylagingizni tugmalang, biroz sovuq.

cards.ex: I like to roll up my sleeves when I'm working.
cards.exUz: Men ishlayotganimda yenglarimni shimishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Yenglarni yoki shimlarning pastki qismini yuqoriga qaytarmoq.

cards.ex: She's a real clothes horse; she spends all her money on clothes.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy modaparast; u barcha pulini kiyimga sarflaydi.

cards.ex: He's always well-dressed, even when he's just running errands.
cards.exUz: U doimo chiroyli kiyingan, hatto u shunchaki ishlarga yugurib yurgan bo'lsa ham.

cards.ex: That shirt is ill-fitting; it's too big for you.
cards.exUz: Bu ko'ylak yomon o'tiradi; u siz uchun juda katta.

cards.ex: The company has a strict dress code: suits for men and dresses for women.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning qat'iy kiyim kodi bor: erkaklar uchun kostyumlar va ayollar uchun ko'ylaklar.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir joyda kiyish kerak bo'lgan kiyim qoidalari.

cards.ex: These leggings are like a second skin; I can wear them all day.
cards.exUz: Bu legginslar xuddi ikkinchi teridek; men ularni kun bo'yi kiyishim mumkin.

cards.ex: Don't forget to use fabric softener when you wash the towels.
cards.exUz: Sochiqlarni yuvayotganda mato yumshatgich ishlatishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Kir yuvishda ishlatiladigan, matolarni yumshatadigan suyuqlik.

cards.ex: I was feeling down, so I went for some retail therapy and bought a new dress.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni yomon his qildim, shuning uchun xarid terapiyasiga bordim va yangi ko'ylak sotib oldim.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni yaxshi his qilish uchun xarid qilish.

cards.ex: They always say to dress for success when you go for a job interview.
cards.exUz: Ular doimo ish suhbatiga borganda muvaffaqiyat uchun kiyinish kerak deyishadi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun o'zingizni professional ko'rsatish maqsadida kiyinish.

cards.ex: Her bright pink hair was definitely a fashion statement.
cards.exUz: Uning yorqin pushti sochlari, albatta, moda bayonoti edi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyim yoki aksessuar orqali o'z shaxsini ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: I found holes in my sweater; I think I have clothes moths.
cards.exUz: Men sviterimda teshiklar topdim; menimcha, menda kiyim kuyalari bor.
